status.en: 228 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Kyiv, Moscow and Odesa.
status.nb: 228 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Kyiv, Moscow og Odesa.

summary.en: In the past week 264 armed incidents were reported, mainly in Kyiv, Moscow and Odesa, and 64 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The UCDP recorded 75 767 battle‑related deaths in 2024. Recent attacks include Russian glide‑bomb and drone strikes that killed at least 20 people in Zaporizhzhia, injured dozens in Kyiv’s Obolon and Holosiivskyi districts, and hit a medical facility in Kharkiv. Trump has called for a new Ukrainian president, linking the diesel deal and the war’s continuation.
summary.nb: I løpet av den siste uken ble 264 væpnede hendelser rapportert, hovedsakelig i Kyiv, Moskva og Odesa, og 64 av dem ble dekket av to eller flere medier. UCDP registrerte 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Nylige angrep inkluderer russiske glide‑bombe- og dronstrike som drepte minst 20 personer i Zaporizhzhia, såret dusinvis i Kyivs Obolon- og Holosiivskyi-distrikt, og traff en medisinsk fasilitet i Kharkiv. Trump har krevd en ny ukrainsk president og knyttet dieselforhandlingen til krigens fortsatte utvikling.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
